content_metadata.description: A promotional presentation for "Solance", an Indian automobile battery manufacturer, blending facts about the Indian automobile industry and Solance's manufacturing processes and facilities.

qAndA.answer: The video shows that Solance conducts over 65 tests on each battery before it reaches the consumer, demonstrating its commitment to quality control.
qAndA.question: How does Solance ensure the quality of its batteries?

qAndA.answer: Solance offers a diverse range of batteries, including two-wheeler, UPS, and four-wheeler batteries.
qAndA.question: What are the different types of batteries manufactured by Solance?

qAndA.answer: The video emphasizes Solance's use of advanced and futuristic technology, as well as fully automatic equipment sourced globally, indicating a commitment to cutting-edge manufacturing practices.
qAndA.question: How is Solance's manufacturing process different?

qAndA.answer: The video conveys a sense of pride, excitement, and confidence in Solance's potential. This is achieved through a combination of inspiring music, dynamic visuals, and a strong narrative of growth and success.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the video?

qAndA.answer: The video encourages viewers to become a part of Solance's growth story, either as customers, associates, or investors, highlighting the potential for mutual benefit and success.
qAndA.question: What is the call to action in the video?

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: The world is watching every move of India in a race to economic supremacy.
India growth story is turning into a global epic.
The successful rollout of make-in India campaign will propel India to emerge as a global manufacturing
hub.
The Indian automobile industry is one of the largest in the world.
The industry accounts for 7.1% of GDP.
Today this sector is around $74 billion in industry and by 2026 the industry is expected to
achieve a turnover of $300 billion.
This sector is one of the key drivers of economy and the Indian automobile battery manufacturers
are also carrying out.
Automobile battery industries are the backbone of automobile andcillary industry.
The battery industry in India that comprises sealed maintenance free automobile batteries,
head-asset batteries and tubular batteries has been registering a 25% and will grow.
This portrays unprecedented potential for the battery manufacturers to grow and to be a part of this
mammoth demand and to brighten up the positive action back landscape of automobile battery industry.
Our name always emerges, our name always creating a new landmark of quality, innovation and growth.
We are proudly introducing our brand.
So, lands.
So, lands batteries have been leaving its footprints on undrivaled quality and innovation.
The giant leap of progress will mark unveiling of brand solens, a product by solens industries.
Solens has the world-class range of two wheeler, UPS and four wheeler batteries.
The robust product portfolio is built on intense research and path-breaking innovation.
The entire manufacturing architecture is built on futuristic and advanced technologies
and flawless testing facilities to deliver world-class quality.
To tap into the huge potential of the automobile battery industry,
the facility is equipped with fully automatic equipment from all over the world
and a sophisticated lab for testing raw materials and the products.
The manufacturing plant in Amdabad has the capacity to manufacture over 3 million batteries per annum.
All the batteries are going through more than 65 tests by the time it reaches the consumer.
Solens is driven by highly experienced team and technical experts.
The team Solens is a great combination of bubbling youth and experience seniors
who are always ready to deliver the best in terms of quality and supply.
In Solens, we believe to make customers happy and providing them the best quality products at very competent drains.
Solens is crafted to ride a new wave of growth on the back of unmatched, corporate identity.
By July 2017, almost less than two years of establishment.
Solens have more than 10 branches and more than 3000 dealers' distributors across India.
To assure about the quality consistency, brand Solens is an ISO 9001 2015 and CE certified company.
In May 2017, Solens won the quality mark award for excellence in automobile batteries.
Unbeatable broader features.
Solens is driven by excellence, riding on higher standards of corporate governance.
All set to scale a new height of quality, performance and growth.
It will create great value for all its stakeholders, customers, associates, company affiliates and investors.
So come and be a part of this never before growth saga.
Be with us, be with growth.
Solens powered by innovation.
